facts.business: Mahip Industries Limited (formerly Care Corupack Ltd) is engaged in manufacturing operations using Kraft Paper as basic raw material.

auditor.name: M/s. B. A. Bedawala & Co., Chartered Accountants, Ahmedabad

key_risks: Increase in prices of basic raw material (Kraft Paper) may have adverse impact on operations and financial conditions
facts.related_party_note: The Company has an outstanding loan/advance as on 31st March, 2026, amounting given to a relative of a Director and a person in whom the Director is interested, in contravention of the provisions of Section 185 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the company has not filed Form MGT-14 before giving loan and advances as per section 179 (3) of the Companies Act, 2013.
